dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: At least four prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures on the mid-dorsal region featuring a sharp high-contrast transition from a dark charcoal-grey exterior to a light-grey interior perimeter; edges are characterized by high-frequency jagged geometry.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid white/light-grey pixel clusters, approximately 10-30 pixels in diameter, located near the posterior-lateral flank; these lack internal gradients and are distinct from the annular patterns.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Geometric relationship defined by the centroids of the three largest mid-dorsal rings forming a scalene triangle; additional keypoint located at a prominent light-grey blob near the tail flipper.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense concentration of small, high-contrast light-grey punctate markings on the head and neck region, forming a marbled appearance distinct from the larger dorsal annuli.
